meta.title: Request a feasibility study
meta.description: Ask for a feasibility study for your hotel: your STEG bills, a site visit, installer quotes and a bankable report. Price on request.

hero.title: From estimate
hero.lede: Tell us about your hotel. A member of the team replies within two working days with what a study would cost.

about.title: What the study covers

items.visit: A site visit: plant room, gas meter and space for a chiller
items.bills: Twelve months of your STEG electricity and gas bills, analysed
items.quotes: Two installer quotes on the same specification
items.report: A bankable report, with the FTE subsidy file prepared

about.priceNote: It depends on the hotel's size and the data available.
about.timelineBody: A few weeks from the site visit, depending on how fast the bills arrive.
